summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by checking for forbidden characters early in the URLValidator. It introduces a new script for reproducing the error, which is not part of the core change but can be useful.

issues.description: The addition of a new script (reproduce_error.py) is not directly related to the core change in URLValidator. While it can be useful, it should ideally be part of the test suite or documentation rather than the main codebase.
The new lines of code do not follow the existing style in terms of spacing around operators and comments. The comment could be more descriptive about why these specific characters are being checked.
